| **Top Velocity** | 30–40 km/h (16–22 knots)| Stated manufacturer testing speed |
| **Battery Chemistry** | Ternary Lithium (NMC) | Marine-grade enclosed battery enclosure |
| **Battery Capacity** | 5.8 kWh | High energy density optimized for marine balance |
| **Cycle Life** | 800 Full Cycles | Retains high capacity over years of commercial use |
| **Operational Endurance** | 40–60 Minutes | Typical water sports session duration |
| **Max Payload** | 150 kg | Single pilot + luggage / personal gear |
| **Displacement (Bare Hull)** | 56 kg | Dual-person lift and loading |

| **Full Charging Time** | 4–5 Hours | Zero three-phase commercial grid upgrade needed |
| **Cooling Architecture** | Natural Closed Water Flow | Heat dissipation via passive underwater hydrodynamics |

## 4. Indian Commercial Water Sports Economics & ROI
Imported petrol jet skis (such as Yamaha WaveRunner EX/VX or Sea-Doo Spark/GTI) face heavy import tariffs (approx 50%–70%), freight costs, and GST in India, pushing their on-road purchase price to ₹18 Lakhs to ₹32 Lakhs.
Furthermore:
- **Daily Fuel Consumption**: Petrol jet skis consume 15 to 25 liters of high-octane petrol and 2-stroke lubricant oil per hour of active operation. In locations like Goa or Kerala, operating a petrol jet ski costs ₹4,000 to ₹7,000 daily in fuel alone.
- **RUVO Daily Cost**: Consumes approximately 6 kWh of electricity per complete charge cycle. At Indian commercial electricity rates (₹8 to ₹12 per unit), a full charge costs **under ₹75**.
- **Net Operating Saving**: ₹3,500 to ₹6,500 daily per unit. For a resort fleet operating 4 craft over a 200-day tourist season, annual fuel savings exceed **₹28,00,000 to ₹52,00,000**.
- **Zero Carbon Marine Zones**: Enables operations in protected eco-sensitive zones, inland bird sanctuaries, backwaters, and pristine lake reservoirs where petrol emissions and engine noise are prohibited by Indian environmental regulations.

## 5. Regional Indian Deployment Matrix
- **Goa**: Calangute, Baga, Candolim, Anjuna, Colva, Morjim, Miramar.
- **Kerala**: Kochi Marine Drive, Kovalam, Varkala, Kumarakom, Alleppey (Alappuzha) backwaters.
- **Maharashtra**: Alibaug (Varsoli, Nagaon), Mandwa, Tarkarli, Malvan, Mumbai Juhu/Girgaon, Pawna Lake, Lavasa.
- **Karnataka**: Gokarna (Om Beach, Kudle), Karwar, Malpe (Udupi), Mangalore Panambur.
- **Andhra Pradesh & Telangana**: Rushikonda Beach (Visakhapatnam), Bhavani Island (Vijayawada), Hussain Sagar (Hyderabad), Nagarjuna Sagar.
- **Tamil Nadu & Puducherry**: Marina Beach, Kovalam (Covelong), Pondicherry Promenade & Paradise Beach.
- **Gujarat**: Daman, Diu, Mandvi Beach (Kutch), Sabarmati Riverfront (Ahmedabad).
- **Inland Lakes & Hill Resorts**: Lake Pichola & Fateh Sagar (Udaipur), Rishikesh Ganges quiet reaches, Nainital, Bhopal Upper Lake.
- **Islands**: Port Blair, Havelock (Swaraj Dweep), Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep).
